Our company!! My company!! Your company!! 
YOUR RESPECTED COMPANY!!!

With the sheer zeal of a hardcore 
salesman, Gold Ship defeated Tosen Jordan. 
On top of that, she acquired a brand-new 
keyword.

The two promised to battle again on a 
grand stage. However, the mystery 
surrounding the keyword, the sender— and 
Eden itself—only continued to deepen.
